Context: 12. Commutation of Pension

2. Amount admissible.Not exceeding 40% of monthly pension. Any fraction in the amount offered for commutation will be ignored.  
There is no provision for commutation of a percentage of basic pension on a second or subsequent occasion within overall maximum limit of 40%. - OM, dated 31-10-2022.  
Illustration.Emoluments t 31,500. 12 years.
